verdict.rationale: Vendor docs say Copilot creates and refines files: prompt and upload notes, then refine in chat in Word; go from prompt to presentation in PowerPoint; and tweak Excel work via chat. A hands-on trial report concretely contradicts the Word editing claim, saying Copilot could only append to the end of a document and could not create tables, search and replace, or maintain formatting. Missing for 10: independent confirmation that iterative in-place editing works, documented export options or formats, evidence for PowerPoint iteration beyond initial generation.
